user.title: Connect an indoor station
user.description: Enter your station's address. SSH must already be enabled. No companion app or YAML package is needed.

trust.title: Verify the station's SSH identity

credentials.title: Authenticate and verify compatibility
credentials.description: Supported: DS-KH6320-WTE1 running V2.2.108 build 250718, English 1024x600 display layout. This integration requires administrator/root Debug access and checks the running firmware binary. Other firmware is refused. Passwords are stored in HA configuration and may be included in backups.

data.supported_device: I administer this device and confirm the supported model, firmware and layout

reauth_confirm.title: Update the station password
reauth_confirm.description: The previously verified SSH key remains pinned. Enter the new station administrator password.

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: The existing SSH key remains pinned. Leave password empty to retain the stored password. For a replacement device or deliberately changed host key, remove and add the integration again, verifying the new fingerprint.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid station address and port.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or verify the pinned SSH key. Check SSH, address, port and network access.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication or Debug unlock failed. Verify the station administrator password.
error.unsupported_device: This release supports only the stated model, firmware and display layout.
error.unsupported_firmware: The running firmware binary does not match the verified compatibility profile. No display controls were sent.
error.discovery_failed: Unable to read a complete supported camera catalog. Check that no separate diagnostic capture is running.

init.title: Polling and requested brightness
init.description: Discovery also runs before every camera selection. Changing default brightness here does not immediately send a display command.
